entries.reason: `IF NOT NULL-UCB` after `PERFORM UNTIL END-OF-TIOT` (276) tests the last TIOT entry the loop reached before the terminator (the loop stops on the zero length byte, so TIOT-ENTRY still addresses the last real DD). Its false arm needs that entry to carry a zero UCB token. The case states its step in `mvs_step` (CREASTMT STEP040, the DDs in CREASTMT.JCL order), and the last DD is HTMLFILE:UCB: ggtiot.c (and DetMvs.java) lay a non-zero token at entry +17..19 for every :UCB DD, so the arm is not taken for this step. A step ending in a :NOUCB DD (as test_tiot_walk_5856.py does for a one-DD step) would take it, but that is a different job step than the one this case proves, so it is stated here, not a loosened proof.

`EVALUATE WS-FL-DD` has WHEN 'TRNXFILE', 'XREFFILE', 'CUSTFILE', 'ACCTFILE' and 'READTRNX'. WS-FL-DD is `VALUE 'TRNXFILE'` (67) and is written only at 760, 779, 797 and 851, each with one of 'READTRNX', 'CUSTFILE', 'ACCTFILE' and 'XREFFILE', so 0000-START (reached by fall-through and `GO TO 0000-START` at those four lines) never sees another value.

`IF END-OF-FILE = 'N'` is the first statement inside `PERFORM UNTIL END-OF-FILE = 'Y'` (317). END-OF-FILE is `VALUE 'N'` (70) and is written only at 357 (`MOVE 'Y'`), so inside the body it is 'N' whenever the loop test lets it in; the false arm would need a value that is neither 'Y' nor 'N'.
